geo_constraints: Applies to Google's AI research, products and services worldwide

locale_context.culture: US big-tech corporate governance: high-level principles, product review processes; 2025 revision dropped explicit weapons/surveillance pledges.

key_dates.event: Original Google AI Principles published (7 objectives + 'AI applications we will not pursue')
Revised AI Principles published (Bold innovation; Responsible development and deployment; Collaborative progress, together), removing the 2018 list of applications Google would not pursue

covered_systems: Google AI models, products and services
objective: States the principles that guide Google's AI research, development and deployment: pursuing bold innovation where benefits substantially outweigh foreseeable risks, developing and deploying AI responsibly with human oversight and safeguards, and collaborating with others.
conflict_rule: Corporate principles; applicable law prevails. The 2025 text refers to alignment with widely accepted principles of international law and human rights.

record_provenance.notes: The official page could not be fetched (network policy), so clauses are paraphrases (text_is_verbatim=false), though several phrases are corroborated by search-result excerpts. Revision date 4 Feb 2025 per contemporaneous press and Google's 'Responsible AI: Our 2024 report and ongoing work' post. The 2018 AI Principles (published 7 June 2018) are superseded; the 2025 revision removed the 2018 commitments not to pursue weapons and certain surveillance applications. Wording of the third principle reported variously ('Collaborative progress, together'); not verified on the live page. No later revision found as of Nov 2026 (not exhaustively verified). binding=false: corporate principles binding on Google only as internal policy.
